author: 5kO0
content: Sync now syncing properly. Manual push from agent subprocess (git push origin crosslink/hub from inside .hub-cache) worked fine — landed at 406cb6d. After that, crosslink sync runs clean, no more (offline) warnings. Crosslink's internal git push still fails for unknown reasons (worth filing as a 2nd upstream bug if it persists). Pragmatic workaround: user runs git push origin crosslink/hub periodically, or git push --all to bundle with main pushes. All locks released.
